date: "2026-10-13"

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

d_raw <- read_csv("acute_yield_data_fall_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

glimpse(d_raw)
```


```{r}
cat("Rows:", nrow(d_raw), "\n")
print(colSums(is.na(d_raw)))

# Each year x cultivar x intensity x treatment should have 3 rows (plots 1-3)
d_raw |> count(year, cultivar, intensity_group, treatment) |> print(n = Inf)
```



```{r}
d <- d_raw |>
  mutate(
    treatment       = factor(treatment, levels = c("Control", "OTC")),
    intensity_group = factor(intensity_group, levels = c("D", "C", "B", "A")),  # D = 1 pulse ... A = 4 pulses
    pulses          = c(D = 1, C = 2, B = 3, A = 4)[as.character(intensity_group)],
    year            = factor(year),
    total_n         = rotten_n + healthy_n,
    total_weight    = rotten_weight + healthy_weight,
    prop_healthy_n  = healthy_n / total_n,
    prop_healthy_wt = healthy_weight / total_weight,
    pair_id         = paste(year, cultivar, intensity_group, plot, sep = "_")
  )

# Every pair_id should have exactly 2 rows (Control + OTC)
d |> count(pair_id) |> count(n)

resp <- c("total_weight", "healthy_weight", "prop_healthy_n", "prop_healthy_wt")
ylab_map <- c(total_weight    = "Total fruit weight (g)",
              healthy_weight  = "Healthy fruit weight (g)",
              prop_healthy_n  = "Proportion healthy (by count)",
              prop_healthy_wt = "Proportion healthy (by weight)")
```


```{r}
# ---------- 3. Descriptive statistics ----------
desc <- d |>
  group_by(year, cultivar, intensity_group, treatment) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(resp), list(mean = mean, sd = sd)), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
print(desc, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```


```{r}
# ---------- 4. Paired differences (OTC - Control) ----------
pairs <- d |>
  select(pair_id, year, cultivar, intensity_group, pulses, plot, treatment, all_of(resp)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = all_of(resp)) |>
  mutate(
    diff_total_weight   = total_weight_OTC    - total_weight_Control,
    diff_healthy_weight = healthy_weight_OTC  - healthy_weight_Control,
    diff_prop_n         = prop_healthy_n_OTC  - prop_healthy_n_Control,
    diff_prop_wt        = prop_healthy_wt_OTC - prop_healthy_wt_Control
  )

pairs |>
  group_by(year, cultivar, intensity_group) |>
  summarise(across(starts_with("diff_"), mean), .groups = "drop") |>
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```


```{r}
plot_paired <- function(r) {
  ggplot(d, aes(treatment, .data[[r]], group = pair_id, colour = treatment)) +
    geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_grid(year + cultivar ~ intensity_group,
               labeller = labeller(intensity_group = function(x) paste("Intensity", x))) +
    labs(y = ylab_map[[r]], x = NULL,
         title = paste("Paired plots:", ylab_map[[r]]),
         subtitle = "Each line connects one Control plot and its paired OTC plot") +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

plot_paired("total_weight")
```


```{r}
plot_paired("healthy_weight")
```


```{r}
plot_paired("prop_healthy_wt")
```


```{r}
plot_paired("prop_healthy_n")
```
